title: Agents
summary: An agent chooses steps toward a goal — it needs boundaries and limited tools.

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What Will You Understand?** An **Agent** chooses steps toward a goal — with boundaries and limited tools.
- **Why Now?** After **LLM** and **RAG** — a decision within the flow when the path is not fixed.

sections.heading: Tension — The agent acts without being asked
sections.subtitle: The agent acts without being asked
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Confirmation messages for all clients — even those who did not complain. Or an endless loop.
- An **Agent** without a **Boundary** = risk.
bullets: Confirmation messages for all clients — even those who did not complain. Or an endless loop.

sections.heading: Core idea — Fixed Workflow vs Agent
sections.subtitle: Fixed Workflow vs Agent
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Workflow:** A → B → C — great for known repetitive tasks.
- **Agent:** Goal + tools — decides the order until it reaches the goal or stops.
- A smart **Agent** + boundaries + few tools = safe.
